easy: Made by crossing threads over and under each other.

ex.en: The woven blanket felt warm and soft.
ex.ko: 그 짠 담요는 따뜻하고 부드러웠다.

easy: Knowing someone a little, but not as well as a close friend.

ex.en: She is just an acquaintance from my swim class.
ex.ko: 그녀는 수영 수업에서 알게 된 지인일 뿐이다.

easy: To hide and wait, then jump out to surprise someone.

ex.en: The cat ambushed the toy mouse from behind the couch.
ex.ko: 고양이가 소파 뒤에서 장난감 쥐를 기습했다.

easy: To change something that is written so it is better or fixed.

ex.en: The teacher amended the rules after we asked.
ex.ko: 선생님은 우리가 부탁하자 규칙을 고치셨다.

easy: Acting like you are better than everyone else.

ex.en: His arrogance made it hard for him to make friends.
ex.ko: 그의 거만함 때문에 친구를 사귀기 어려웠다.

easy: Very loud, in a way that hurts your ears.

ex.en: The blasting music woke up the whole street.
ex.ko: 요란한 음악이 온 동네를 깨웠다.

easy: To become hard to see clearly, like when you are very sleepy.

ex.en: My eyes began to blur when I read late at night.
ex.ko: 밤늦게 책을 읽으니 눈이 흐릿해지기 시작했다.

easy: To make something look less sharp or clear.

ex.en: Rain blurred the window, so I could not see outside.
ex.ko: 비 때문에 창문이 흐려져서 밖이 보이지 않았다.

easy: To dance in a fun, bouncy way to music.

ex.en: We boogied in the living room after dinner.
ex.ko: 우리는 저녁 식사 후 거실에서 신나게 춤을 췄다.

easy: The line of short hair above your eye.

ex.en: He raised one brow when I told the joke.
ex.ko: 내가 농담을 하자 그는 한쪽 눈썹을 치켜올렸다.

easy: A round vegetable with many green leaves packed tightly together.

ex.en: Our rabbit loves to eat cabbage leaves.
ex.ko: 우리 토끼는 양배추 잎 먹는 걸 좋아한다.

easy: To bring and serve food at a party.

ex.en: A local restaurant catered our school picnic.
ex.ko: 동네 식당이 우리 학교 소풍에 음식을 제공했다.

easy: Covered with clouds, so you cannot see much sun.

ex.en: It was too cloudy to see the stars.
ex.ko: 구름이 너무 많이 껴서 별이 보이지 않았다.

easy: Able to change into something else that you can use in a new way.

ex.en: We have a convertible sofa that turns into a bed.
ex.ko: 우리 집에는 침대로 바뀌는 소파가 있다.

easy: Growing bigger as more and more is added over time.

ex.en: My cumulative score grows after every game.
ex.ko: 내 누적 점수는 경기마다 늘어난다.

easy: A person who takes care of the art or things in a museum.

ex.en: The curator showed us the dinosaur bones.
ex.ko: 큐레이터가 우리에게 공룡 뼈를 보여 주었다.

easy: A sickness when you must go to the bathroom a lot and it is watery.

ex.en: I had diarrhea after eating bad food, so I stayed home.
ex.ko: 상한 음식을 먹고 설사를 해서 집에 있었다.

easy: A shape that has been twisted out of its true form.

ex.en: The funny mirror showed a distortion of my face, with a huge nose.
ex.ko: 웃긴 거울에는 코가 엄청 큰, 일그러진 내 얼굴이 비쳤다.

easy: Having to do with the highest degree you can get from a university.

ex.en: My aunt is studying for a doctoral degree.
ex.ko: 우리 이모는 박사 학위 과정을 공부하고 있다.

easy: A person whose job is to teach young people.

ex.en: Our principal is a kind educator.
ex.ko: 우리 교장 선생님은 친절한 교육자이시다.

easy: Made to look like the real thing, but not real.

ex.en: My jacket has faux fur, not real animal fur.
ex.ko: 내 재킷은 진짜 동물 털이 아니라 인조 털이다.

easy: Not afraid, even when something is scary or dangerous.

ex.en: My fearless little sister jumped off the high diving board.
ex.ko: 겁 없는 내 여동생이 높은 다이빙대에서 뛰어내렸다.

easy: A small bird with a short, strong beak for eating seeds.

ex.en: A yellow finch ate seeds from our bird feeder.
ex.ko: 노란 핀치가 우리 새 모이통의 씨앗을 먹었다.

easy: Stopping for a moment because you cannot decide what to do or say.

ex.en: After a long hesitation, I picked chocolate ice cream.
ex.ko: 한참 망설인 끝에 나는 초콜릿 아이스크림을 골랐다.

easy: Not wanting to do something yet because you feel unsure.

ex.en: I felt hesitation about jumping into the cold pool.
ex.ko: 나는 차가운 수영장에 뛰어드는 게 망설여졌다.

easy: A very bad feeling when others see you do something shameful or silly.

ex.en: He felt humiliation when everyone laughed at his mistake.
ex.ko: 모두가 그의 실수를 비웃자 그는 굴욕감을 느꼈다.

easy: Having many small parts put together in a detailed way.

ex.en: The spider made an intricate web.
ex.ko: 거미가 정교한 거미줄을 쳤다.

easy: A sport from Japan where you block, kick, and punch with your hands and feet.

ex.en: I wear a white uniform at karate class.
ex.ko: 나는 가라테 수업에서 하얀 도복을 입는다.

easy: Living or lasting for a very long time.

ex.en: Turtles are known for their longevity.
ex.ko: 거북이는 장수하는 것으로 유명하다.

easy: Very fancy and comfortable, and costs a lot of money.

ex.en: We stayed in a luxurious hotel with a big pool.
ex.ko: 우리는 큰 수영장이 있는 호화로운 호텔에 묵었다.

easy: Making fun of someone in a mean way.

ex.en: The bully gave a mocking laugh.
ex.ko: 괴롭히는 아이가 비웃는 웃음을 지었다.

easy: Making fun of someone in a playful way, not to be mean.

ex.en: Dad gave me a mocking smile when I lost at checkers.
ex.ko: 내가 체커에서 지자 아빠는 놀리는 듯한 미소를 지으셨다.

easy: Something that blocks the way so you cannot get through.

ex.en: A fallen tree was an obstruction on the road.
ex.ko: 쓰러진 나무가 길을 막는 장애물이었다.

easy: When something is stuck inside and nothing can pass through.

ex.en: A toy stuck in the pipe caused an obstruction.
ex.ko: 배관에 낀 장난감 때문에 막힘이 생겼다.

easy: A very long trip full of exciting things that happen.

ex.en: Our drive across the country was a real odyssey.
ex.ko: 우리의 전국 횡단 자동차 여행은 정말 긴 모험이었다.

easy: A person who is not part of a group.

ex.en: I felt like an outsider on my first day at the new school.
ex.ko: 새 학교 첫날 나는 외부인이 된 것 같았다.

easy: A person who asks a court to help with a problem.

ex.en: The plaintiff told the judge why she was upset.
ex.ko: 원고는 판사에게 왜 속상한지 말했다.

easy: A tree that grows sweet red or purple fruit with a hard seed inside.

ex.en: We climbed the plum tree in Grandpa's yard.
ex.ko: 우리는 할아버지 마당의 자두나무에 올라갔다.

easy: A small round fruit with smooth skin and one hard seed in the middle.

ex.en: I bit into a juicy plum.
ex.ko: 나는 즙이 많은 자두를 한 입 베어 물었다.

easy: Playing a character in a play or movie.

ex.en: Her portrayal of the wicked witch scared the little kids.
ex.ko: 그녀가 연기한 나쁜 마녀 때문에 어린아이들이 무서워했다.

easy: A short, soft blast of air.

ex.en: A puff of wind blew my paper off the desk.
ex.ko: 한 줄기 바람이 불어 내 종이가 책상에서 날아갔다.

easy: A light, airy pastry that is hollow inside.

ex.en: I ate a cream puff filled with sweet cream.
ex.ko: 나는 달콤한 크림이 든 슈크림 빵을 먹었다.

easy: A joke that plays with a word that has two meanings.

ex.en: My brother's pun made everyone groan and laugh.
ex.ko: 형의 말장난에 모두가 끙 소리를 내면서도 웃었다.

easy: To make a joke by playing with words that have two meanings.

ex.en: My dad likes to pun at the dinner table.
ex.ko: 아빠는 저녁 식탁에서 말장난하는 걸 좋아하신다.

easy: Wild and out of control, spreading everywhere.

ex.en: Weeds were rampant in our garden.
ex.ko: 우리 정원에는 잡초가 걷잡을 수 없이 자랐다.

easy: Controlling something by making rules for it.

ex.en: Regulating how fast cars go keeps our school street safe.
ex.ko: 자동차 속도를 규제하면 우리 학교 앞 도로가 안전해진다.

easy: To make an exact copy of something.

ex.en: Scientists replicate an experiment to see if they get the same result.
ex.ko: 과학자들은 같은 결과가 나오는지 보려고 실험을 재현한다.

easy: The flat top part of a building.

ex.en: We watched the fireworks from the rooftop.
ex.ko: 우리는 옥상에서 불꽃놀이를 구경했다.

easy: When a plant grows roots and starts to grow.

ex.en: The rooting of my bean plant took only a few days.
ex.ko: 내 콩 식물이 뿌리내리는 데는 며칠밖에 걸리지 않았다.

easy: A big van-like home on wheels that people use for camping.

ex.en: We drove our RV to the lake for the weekend.
ex.ko: 우리는 주말에 캠핑카를 타고 호수에 갔다.

easy: Something you do to stop a bad thing before it happens.

ex.en: A helmet is a safeguard when you ride a bike.
ex.ko: 헬멧은 자전거를 탈 때 사고를 막아 주는 안전장치다.

easy: Covered with small, hard, flat pieces, like a fish.

ex.en: The scaled lizard sat in the sun.
ex.ko: 비늘로 덮인 도마뱀이 햇볕을 쬐고 있었다.

easy: A car with four seats or more and a closed top.

ex.en: Our family car is a blue sedan.
ex.ko: 우리 가족 차는 파란색 세단이다.

easy: Dirty water and waste that flows away through pipes under the ground.

ex.en: Pipes carry sewage to a cleaning plant.
ex.ko: 관이 하수를 정화 시설로 보낸다.

easy: A funny show about the things that happen in everyday life.

ex.en: My family laughs together at a sitcom every Friday.
ex.ko: 우리 가족은 매주 금요일마다 함께 시트콤을 보며 웃는다.

easy: A funny TV show about everyday life, with the same people each week.

ex.en: The new sitcom is about a family with five dogs.
ex.ko: 새 시트콤은 개 다섯 마리를 키우는 가족 이야기다.

easy: Full of energy and fun.

ex.en: The spirited puppy ran in circles.
ex.ko: 활기찬 강아지가 빙글빙글 뛰어다녔다.

easy: To order someone to come to court.

ex.en: The judge summoned the witness to come to court.
ex.ko: 판사는 증인을 법정에 소환했다.

easy: To ask someone to come to you.

ex.en: The principal summoned me to her office.
ex.ko: 교장 선생님이 나를 교장실로 부르셨다.

easy: A message sent long ago over wires using a code of clicks.

ex.en: Long ago, people sent a telegram to share fast news.
ex.ko: 옛날에는 빠른 소식을 전하려고 전보를 보냈다.

easy: A light, very strong gray metal used in planes and bikes.

ex.en: My bike frame is made of titanium.
ex.ko: 내 자전거 프레임은 티타늄으로 만들어졌다.

easy: Water or air that moves in a wild, bumpy way.

ex.en: Turbulence in the river tossed our raft around.
ex.ko: 강의 거센 소용돌이가 우리 뗏목을 이리저리 흔들었다.

easy: Bumpy, rough movement of air, like when a plane shakes.

ex.en: The plane shook from turbulence, and I held my seat tight.
ex.ko: 비행기가 난기류로 흔들려서 나는 의자를 꽉 잡았다.

easy: Not smooth or the same all over.

ex.en: The uneven path made my bike bounce.
ex.ko: 울퉁불퉁한 길 때문에 자전거가 덜컹거렸다.

easy: A strong need to do something very fast.

ex.en: I felt a sense of urgency when the school bus began to leave.
ex.ko: 스쿨버스가 출발하려 하자 나는 급한 마음이 들었다.

easy: How important it is to act right away.

ex.en: She ran to the bus stop with great urgency.
ex.ko: 그녀는 몹시 급하게 버스 정류장으로 달려갔다.

easy: A musical instrument with metal bars that you hit with soft sticks.

ex.en: The music teacher played a slow song on the vibes.
ex.ko: 음악 선생님이 비브라폰으로 느린 곡을 연주하셨다.

easy: A coat that keeps rain off you.

ex.en: He wore a yellow waterproof to school on rainy days.
ex.ko: 그는 비 오는 날 노란 우비를 입고 학교에 갔다.

easy: In a very good way.

ex.en: She plays the violin wonderfully.
ex.ko: 그녀는 바이올린을 훌륭하게 연주한다.

easy: The words you choose to say or write something.

ex.en: Change the wording so the question is easier to understand.
ex.ko: 질문이 더 쉽게 이해되도록 표현을 바꿔 보세요.

easy: The world of colleges and the people who study and teach there.

ex.en: My uncle left his job to work in academia.
ex.ko: 삼촌은 직장을 그만두고 학계에서 일하게 되었다.

easy: To be the person in charge of running something.

ex.en: Ms. Lee administers the school library.
ex.ko: 이 선생님은 학교 도서관을 관리하신다.

easy: Used when you agree that something is true.

ex.en: Admittedly, I forgot to feed the fish.
ex.ko: 솔직히 인정하는데, 내가 물고기 밥 주는 걸 깜빡했어.

easy: To say your ideas clearly in words.

ex.en: I tried to articulate why I felt sad.
ex.ko: 나는 내가 왜 슬픈지 말로 표현하려고 애썼다.

easy: Staying away from something on purpose.

ex.en: Avoidance of sugary drinks keeps your teeth healthy.
ex.ko: 단 음료를 피하면 치아가 건강해진다.

easy: A small shop that sells fancy clothes.

ex.en: Mom bought my dress at a boutique.
ex.ko: 엄마는 부티크에서 내 원피스를 사 주셨다.

easy: A meal where the food is set out and you serve yourself.

ex.en: We ate at a buffet and tried five desserts.
ex.ko: 우리는 뷔페에서 디저트를 다섯 가지나 먹어 봤다.

easy: The round part on a stove that gets hot for cooking.

ex.en: Do not touch the hot burner.
ex.ko: 뜨거운 화구를 만지지 마.

easy: The baseball player who squats behind home plate and catches the pitches.

ex.en: The catcher caught the fast pitch.
ex.ko: 포수가 빠른 공을 잡았다.

easy: The spot on a baseball team behind home plate, where you catch the pitches.

ex.en: A catcher needs a lot of protective gear.
ex.ko: 포수는 보호 장비가 많이 필요하다.

easy: Words that make something easier to understand.

ex.en: The teacher's clarification helped me understand fractions.
ex.ko: 선생님이 설명해 주셔서 분수를 이해하게 됐다.

easy: A good feeling that helps when you are sad or disappointed.

ex.en: The warm blanket was a consolation after my bad day.
ex.ko: 따뜻한 담요는 힘든 하루를 보낸 나에게 위안이 되었다.

easy: Kind words or actions that make a sad person feel better.

ex.en: Mom's hug was a great consolation when my dog was sick.
ex.ko: 강아지가 아팠을 때 엄마의 포옹은 큰 위로가 되었다.

easy: Secret and kept hidden.

ex.en: The spies made a covert plan.
ex.ko: 스파이들은 은밀한 계획을 세웠다.

easy: A picture or drawing that shows what something looks like.

ex.en: This painting is a depiction of a sunny day at the beach.
ex.ko: 이 그림은 화창한 날의 해변을 묘사한 것이다.

easy: Telling what something is like, with lots of details.

ex.en: Write a descriptive story with lots of colors and sounds.
ex.ko: 색깔과 소리가 많이 들어간 묘사하는 이야기를 써 보세요.

easy: A sudden loss of power, success, or a good name.

ex.en: Lying was his downfall.
ex.ko: 거짓말이 그의 몰락의 원인이었다.

easy: Rain or snow falling from the sky.

ex.en: A heavy downfall of snow closed our school.
ex.ko: 폭설로 우리 학교가 문을 닫았다.

easy: A bad part of something that is mostly good.

ex.en: The downside of a pet is cleaning up after it.
ex.ko: 반려동물의 단점은 뒤처리를 해야 한다는 거야.

easy: A machine that makes wet clothes dry with warm air.

ex.en: Please put the wet towels in the dryer.
ex.ko: 젖은 수건을 건조기에 넣어 줘.

easy: To jump high and slam the basketball down through the hoop.

ex.en: Our tall coach dunked the ball.
ex.ko: 키 큰 코치님이 공을 덩크슛으로 꽂아 넣었다.

easy: Coming right after something else.

ex.en: We heard thunder, and the ensuing rain soaked our picnic.
ex.ko: 천둥소리가 났고 뒤이어 내린 비에 우리 소풍이 흠뻑 젖었다.

easy: Ideas about what is right and what is wrong.

ex.en: Honesty is part of our family's ethic.
ex.ko: 정직은 우리 가족 윤리의 일부이다.

easy: A set of rules about how to act in a good, fair way.

ex.en: Our team has an ethic: play fair and be kind.
ex.ko: 우리 팀에는 공정하게 경기하고 친절하자는 윤리 규범이 있다.

easy: To stop being good to use because the time is over.

ex.en: The milk expired yesterday, so do not drink it.
ex.ko: 우유 유통기한이 어제 만료됐으니 마시지 마.

easy: A place in a wall where you can build a fire to keep a room warm.

ex.en: We hung our stockings by the fireplace.
ex.ko: 우리는 벽난로 옆에 양말을 걸어 두었다.

easy: A special natural skill at something.

ex.en: She has a flair for drawing animals.
ex.ko: 그녀는 동물 그리기에 소질이 있다.

easy: A fun, stylish way of doing things that people notice.

ex.en: He dances with flair.
ex.ko: 그는 멋지게 춤춘다.

easy: A number that shows how good your grades are.

ex.en: My cousin worked hard to keep a high GPA.
ex.ko: 사촌 형은 높은 평점 평균을 유지하려고 열심히 공부했다.

easy: To stay in someone's mind like a ghost that will not leave.

ex.en: The scary movie haunted me for days.
ex.ko: 그 무서운 영화가 며칠 동안 내 머릿속을 떠나지 않았다.

easy: Earphones worn over your head, often with a tiny microphone.

ex.en: I wear a headset to play video games with my cousin.
ex.ko: 나는 사촌과 게임할 때 헤드셋을 쓴다.
